title: Horizontal lead-screw stage
scope: Screw, nut, guide and support envelopes; no thread form, bearing selection, fastening or rated speed/load.
notes: Useful carriage centre x=40..90; guide block extends +/-15; nut extends +/-10.
Fixed support x=0..15, float support x=115..130. Thread region x=25..105; both nut-end margins 5 mm.
Screw x=-10..130 includes 10 mm coupling engagement; motor shaft ends x=-11 leaving 1 mm between shaft ends. Coupling bores/engagement require selection.
Stop contact planes x=20,110 give block-centre stops x=35,95: 5 mm beyond each commanded endpoint. Sensor trigger and stopping margin still require selected hardware.
